title: Balance formation of aluminum oxide
hints: Balance oxygen with an even product coefficient.
Two formula units contain six O atoms.
solution: $\ce{4Al + 3O2 -> 2Al2O3}$. For one mole of product use coefficients $2,3/2,1$.
statement:
Enter the **smallest whole-number coefficients** for $\ce{Al(s) + O2(g) -> Al2O3(s)}$. Divide through by the product coefficient afterward to obtain the standard formation equation.
